story.victory: DOOM ATTACK REPELLED before it started: the relay account now meets the password standard. Astro: "A standard is only real once every account actually meets it."

ORDERS FROM ASTRO
=================
Read password-standard.txt, then bring the relay account into compliance: run `sudo passwd relay` and type a password that actually meets every requirement.
files./home/cadet/citadel/password-standard.tx:
CITADEL PASSWORD STANDARD
----------------------------
Every account password must:
1. Be at least 12 characters
2. Mix upper case, lower case, a number, and a symbol
3. Never contain the account name
4. Avoid common words attackers guess first (password, admin, 12345, qwerty, citadel)

The relay account currently fails this standard: password is "starlight" (8 characters, no number, no symbol).

steps.title: Rivet's Workbench: read the standard
steps.body: Rivet: "Read every requirement before you set anything." `cat password-standard.txt`.

steps.title: Bring the account into compliance
steps.body: Rivet: "Twelve-plus characters, mixed case, a number, a symbol, no account name, no common word." `sudo passwd relay`, then type the new password twice.
